meta.name: I-25 / Santa Fe Dr volume balance
meta.description: Built from AK_Volume Balance.xlsx (Baseline 5PM), CDOT TCDS counts and StreetLight TMC 2098249.

i25sb_6th_alameda.note: Spreadsheet AV30: typed 8055 against the 2020 count of 8495 (-5.2%).

i25sb_sf_bwy.note: Spreadsheet AR60 shows 2027-11-02; assumed 2017-11-02 like the other interchange counts.

i25sb_arkansas.note: Spreadsheet derives this (AV74) and compares with the 2010 count.

kal_alameda_i25.note: Spreadsheet BS46 derives this from the 2013 Santa Fe SB count and compares with the 2020 count.

sfnb_i25_alameda.note: Spreadsheet BZ46 derives this and compares with the 2020 count.

tmc_sfsb_split.note: StreetLight reports SBL 1125 and SBT 1125 for the same roadway continuing south (plus SBR 397). Combined as SBT 2250. The spreadsheet typed 2647 as through, which double-counted the 397 right turns in its approach total (3044).

tmc_ariz_sb.note: StreetLight 'Intersection 05' = SB through just north of Arizona (no cross-street movements captured).
